result:
Memo submitted. Summary of findings:

**Three US opex lines cleared both thresholds (>10% and >$5,000) MoM:**

1. **Hosting & Infrastructure**: +$9,646 (+30.8%) — recurring Stackline hosting was flat; driven entirely by a one-time $9,800 data-migration invoice (JE-00258, supported). Holds up.

2. **Travel**: +$6,373 (+811.5%) — normal card spend was flat (+$73); driven almost entirely by a single $6,300 manual entry (JE-00300, "Travel reimbursement - T. Vance," 3/29/26). **This driver does not hold up**: no support attached, self-posted by the employee being reimbursed, no approval on file. Flagged in the memo for controller review rather than forced through.

3. **Marketing Programs**: +$21,788 (+275.9%) — recurring Oakridge agency spend was flat; driven by a one-time $22,000 Meridian Events conference sponsorship (JE-00241, supported). Holds up.

All other expense lines were either flat/<10% or moved >10% but stayed under the $5,000 materiality bar (Software Subscriptions, Training, Depreciation, Bank Fees), so they weren't detailed further per your criteria.
